7、Friday: 30-minute swimming or brisk walking with intervals (alternate 3 minutes fast and 2 minutes slow) to increase intensity. Include planks and supermans (3 sets of 30-60 seconds each) for core stability.
8、Saturday: Engage in a fun physical activity like dancing, hiking, or a sport for at least 45 minutes to make exercise enjoyable and sustainable.
9、Sunday: Rest or gentle stretching. Track progress and set weekly goals to stay motivated. Consider using a fitness app or wearable to monitor steps (aim for 7,000-10,000 daily) and activity.
